svg.aria-label: Pipeline tiers. S: coder, gates, qa, done. M: planner, three parallel coders, gates, tester, qa, senior reviewer, done. L: planner, you approve the plan, build and review as in M, bug-hunter, verify, done. Fix loop: open findings go to a fresh coder and only the raising agents re-verify; the last round escalates the coder to Opus.
